What changes?

Qualitative outcomes only. No measured improvement is claimed.

Before

  • Fragmented information
  • Multiple sources
  • Manual interpretation
  • Limited cross-domain visibility
  • Harder remote understanding

After PROPOSED

  • Connected operational view
  • Station-level context
  • Cross-domain relationships
  • Incident traceability
  • Decision support

What I designed.

Designing for extreme systems changed how I think about UX.

01A dashboard should not just show data. It should help users understand relationships.

02A Digital Twin is not simply a 3D model. The value comes from connected data and system relationships.

3D model + Connected data + Relationships = Digital Twin

03In complex environments, data credibility matters as much as visual polish.

Visual polish
Data credibility
Source labelledSimulated flaggedQuality checked

04Good operational UX reduces cognitive load without hiding complexity.

Status: High risk → Cause: CHP anomaly → Evidence: 18.2 mm/sOne layer at a time. Nothing hidden.
